logp.method_description: Lipophilicity of complexes 1–6 were measured by determining their partition coefficients (logP) between n-octanol and water using the shake-flask method.1 First, an absorbance calibration plot was constructed for the complex at varying concentrations of the complex in the aqueous medium. Then, known concentration of the aqueous solution of the complex was mixed with equal volume of n-octanol. After vortex-shaking the mixture, the two phases were allowed to separate. The remaining concentration of the complex in aqueous phase was then determined from the calibration plot. The partition coefficient was calculated by using the equation logP = log[complex]oct/[complex]aq, where [complex]oct is the concentration of the complex in n-octanol phase and [complex]aq is the concentration in the aqueous phase.
